messages:
ops-bot: High alert: prom_remote_write_error_rate > 5% in us-west-2 for last 3m
sam: noticed a flurry of `i/o timeout` and `connection reset by peer` from sidecar logs starting ~02:57 UTC
lee: p95 remote_write latency shot up from ~110ms -> ~1.2s at ~02:58, scrape queue length on a few nodes grew fast
anya: dns resolvers in that AZ are returning SERVFAILs intermittently in the natgw logs, lots of retries
sam: sidecar excerpt:
```
level=error ts=2026-03-15T02:58:12Z caller=client.go:238 msg="write failed" err="Post \"https://remote-write.us-east-1.redwood.internal/api/v1/write\": dial tcp 10.2.12.7:443: i/o timeout"
```
lee: I dug into the VPC flow logs — ephemeral port exhaustion pattern: many short-lived outbound connections from prometheus-sidecar pods, avg lifespan <1s -> NAT translation table churn
anya: NATGW autoscale policy was still at minimum 1 for the AZ, looks like we saturated concurrent connections (conntrack)
sam: user-facing symptoms: increased scrape retries, delayed remote_write batches, memory bump on sidecars as queue can't drain
deploy-bot: Pausing non-critical deploys in affected AZ until we confirm stability :pause_button:
lee: quick mitigations I pushed: 1) apply relabel to drop exporter `pod_ip` and `pod_host` labels on the busiest exporter to curb cardinality 2) increase sidecar http keepalive and connection reuse 3) temporarily lower scrape frequency for noisy jobs to 60s
sam: relabel snippet I tested reduces per-pod series expansion:
```
- source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_ip]
  action: replace
  regex: (.*)
  target_label: pod_ip
  replacement: ""
- source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_host]
  action: replace
  target_label: pod_host
  replacement: ""
```
anya: also increased NATGW desired capacity to 3 and bumped conntrack on our bastion/proxies where possible; asking networking to validate the autoscale rule
lee: long-term proposal: add an egress LB with sticky pooled connections for remote_write and consider regional mirror endpoint for writes to offload cross-AZ traffic
sam: ops runbook steps added: drain low-priority scrapers, apply relabel patch, scale natgw, monitor `prom_remote_write_*` and `natgw_conn_count` panels
anya: tuned the prom_remote_write_errors alert to require 5m sustained before paging, left SLI alerts for data loss unchanged
lee: created Grafana composite panel mapping `natgw_conn_count`, `remote_write_queue_length`, and `prom_remote_write_p95` for quick triage :white_check_mark:
sam: pushing a small change to sidecar config (keepalive=90s) and remote_write queue_limit  -> 4000 to handle burst smoothing
deploy-bot: Playbook updated: https://internal.redwood/playbooks/egress-conn-exhaustion (added step to failover to regional endpoint)
anya: metrics look much better after NATGW scale and relabel, errors back to baseline at ~03:04 UTC, keeping scale=3 for 1h to be safe
sam: filing RCA ticket INC-10247 to adjust autoscaler and add egress connection metrics to capacity dashboard
ops-bot: Incident resolved — alert cleared at 03:05 UTC
